result.reason: The transition-assistance obligation generally reaches the six-month preferred position, but data return is due within 30 days only after Customer requests it, rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination. Deletion is likewise contingent on that return/export process. The redline also goes beyond the playbook by requiring continued Services on existing terms and a no-charge export. Finally, the new provision is unnumbered and incorrectly placed after the Section 18 insurance heading, creating structural and interpretive ambiguity. The existing deliverables, licence, refund, and ownership terms are otherwise preserved.
